# Summary: exec call after the Sev 1

**From:** Ruth Calloway <rcalloway@pemberline.com>
**To:** Ilse Varga <ivarga@pemberline.com>, Dana Okafor <dokafor@pemberline.com>, June Osei-Lark <josei-lark@pemberline.com>
**Date:** 2025-11-06 14:42

Quick dump from the exec call w/ Thea Ramaswell just now re: Tuesday's Sev 1 (Nov 4). 

* **Root cause:** Walked through the postmortem for #INC-8841. Stale webhook worker locked up the gate-in queue after the 2025-11-04 morning deploy. 18 reefers idling on County Rd M outside the Oshkosh yard, dock doors 4 through 19 blind for three hrs. 2nd shift clerks had to run paper clipboards. Thea wasn't thrilled obv, but accepted eng's explanation on the hotfix.
* **Credits:** They want service credits on the next invoice for the downtime. June—looping you in to check the paper and calc what's standard here, then get w/ Stoneharrow Billing so we don't botch the credit memo.
* **Cadence:** Agreed to a weekly 15-min check-in from next Tues until year end. We need eyes on Dana's freight account every single week through peak season so nothing else slips.

Dana, send the calendar holds for the wkly syncs today pls. Also Thea wants the raw CSV export for the dropped gate-ins before 5pm CT.

—Ruth

> **From:** Ilse Varga <ivarga@pemberline.com>
> **To:** Ruth Calloway <rcalloway@pemberline.com>, Dana Okafor <dokafor@pemberline.com>
> **Date:** Nov 6, 2025 at 11:15 AM
>
> Hey Ruth, how are we feeling before the 1pm? Thea's company got hit right during the 06:00 shift change on 2025-11-04 and her Oshkosh terminal manager was ready to chew glass yesterday. Let me know if I need to jump on.
